notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 object-class Request Attribute Value Update overload over concrete subclass instances. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, rich FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies class-scoped owner solicitation, inherited object-class and attribute handles, provider callback boundaries, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object-class Request Attribute Value Update with FederateAmbassador discovery and provider callbacks
